entries.name: OpenFOAM (OpenCFD distribution)
entries.gpu: Do not infer general GPU solver support from GPU infrastructure/offload announcements; verify solver, model and hardware support for the selected release.

entries.name: SU2
entries.versionTrack: v7 documentation track; pin exact release at integration
entries.gpu: Do not claim GPU execution without release-specific build/runtime evidence; standard SU2 command-line solver can run on CPU and MPI parallelism requires an MPI-enabled build.

entries.name: Code_Saturne
